title: Purify Before You Align: Improving Representation Alignment for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representation alignment improves and accelerates diffusion training by encouraging intermediate features to match a pretrained visual encoder. However, standard alignment matches pretrained representations without distinguishing what information may be more useful for generation. We introduce local appearance purification (LAP), which improves generation quality and makes encoders such as MAE more effective alignment targets by removing locally predictable content and aligning to the residual. LAP modifies only the alignment target, and requires no changes to diffusion training or inference. Through controlled interventions within a fixed encoder, we show that effective alignment depends on what information the target emphasizes, not simply how much image information it contains. translated_title: 先净化再对齐：改进扩散模型的表征对齐
translated_abstract: 表征对齐通过鼓励扩散模型的中间特征去匹配预训练视觉编码器，从而改进并加速扩散模型的训练。然而，标准的对齐方式只是直接匹配预训练表征，并未区分哪些信息对生成任务可能更有用。我们提出了局部外观净化，该方法通过去除局部可预测的内容，使模型对齐到剩余的残差信息，从而提升生成质量，并使诸如 MAE 这类编码器成为更有效的对齐目标。LAP 仅修改对齐目标，无需对扩散模型的训练或推理过程做任何改动。通过在固定编码器内进行受控干预实验，我们证明了对齐的有效性取决于目标所强调的信息内容，而不是它所包含的图像信息总量。我们的理论为标准对齐提供了变分解释，并且对于固定的局部预测器，给出了以（内容截断）为条件的逐 token 信息界的总和。
tldr: 提出局部外观净化（LAP）方法，通过在对齐前去除目标表征中局部可预测的内容、仅对齐残差信息，显著提升扩散模型的生成质量，且无需改动训练或推理流程。
en_tdlr: Proposes Local Appearance Purification (LAP), which improves diffusion generation quality by removing locally predictable content from alignment targets and aligning to the residual, requiring no changes to diffusion training or inference.
